title: Effects of transdermal estrogen on Bone Mass in adolescent female patients with Anorexia nervosa (AN) – a placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomized, interventional study.
summary:
The study is designed to demonstrate the effect of estradiol continuously transdermal applicated as patch in combination with cyclic (days 1-14 of each month) dydrogesterone on Bone Mass after treatment over one year. Additionally, the subjects will get Vit D and Calciumcarbonat for one year.
In adolescent female Anorexia nervosa patients  we expect a significant change in Bone Mass of spine compared to Anorexia nervosa patients with placebo.

interventions.name:
Experimental treatment: 100µg 17-ß-estradiol transdermal patch (day 1-28), 10 mg dydrogesterone oral (day1-14), 400 I.E. Vitamin D oral, 1250 mg Calciumcarbonat oral

Duration of treatment per patient: one year (13 months/28 days)

Follow-up per patient: one year

Control treatment: 100µg 17-ß-estradiol placebo patch (day 1-28), 10 mg dydrogesterone placebo oral (day 1-14), 400 I.E.  Vitamin D oral, 1250 mg Calciumcarbonat oral

Duration of treatment per patient: one year (13 months/28 days)

Follow-up per patient: one year

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• DSM 5 (307.1) for Anorexia nervosa 
• Amenorrhea for a minimum of 3 months preceding study participation
• Age 14-20 years
• Bone age  ≥ 14 years
• BMI-Percentile  ≥  5%
Exclusion criteria:
• Primary amenorrhea
• Premature ovarian failure, as demonstrated by an elevated FSH
• Diseases known to affect bone metabolism including:
-untreated thyreoid disease
-cushing syndrome
-diabetes
-pituitary disease
-renal failure 
-prior bone fracture within 6 months of the study

• Medication known to affect bone metabolism (including gonadal steroids within the last 3 months)
• Evidence of: 
-Suicidality
-Psychosis
-Substance abuse
• Abnormal TSH
• Hematocrit < 30%
Potassium < 3,0 mmol/l
Glucose < 50 mg/dl
• Pregnancy/lactation
• History of malignancy
• Contraindications to estrogen therapy (for girls with AN)
• Smoking
